title: Amount
description: Money set as typography: a locale-grouped figure in the heading face with a small raised currency sign.

size.description: sm = font-size 2xl, md = 3xl, lg = 4xl, xl = 5xl, each with its own tracking. sm is medium weight; md and up are regular.

symbol.description: raised: the currency sign at ~45% size in text.subtle, aligned to the top of the digits (60% for multi-character signs such as US$ or د.إ.), and minor units set smaller. inline: plain text, sign in text.subtle.

tone.description: Colour of the figure: text.default, text.brand, accent.text or the feedback fg role. The sign and fraction stay text.subtle.

compact.description: Compact notation with at most one decimal (₹18K, ₹1.8L, £240k).

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.
